verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye dhātānaṁ dhammānaṁ atthaṁ upaparikkhanti;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who examine the meaning of the teachings they have memorized are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye dhātānaṁ dhammānaṁ atthaṁ na upaparikkhanti.
verses.english: while those who don’t examine the meaning of the teachings are many.
